budget_semantics: Fixed 10000 optimizer-step cap; 12 GPU-hours is a planning estimate including validation and checkpoint I/O, not a changed learning-rate schedule. Simulator evaluation is additional.
selection: Lowest sample-weighted held-out total loss at steps 1500, 5000, 10000; ties choose fewer steps; no simulator scores used.
seed_repeat_decision: One training seed for this reduced-compute study. Three seeds would approximately triple the adaptation cost; training-seed uncertainty is not estimated.
rationale: The completed pilot fits the RTX 3090 and projects approximately ten hours for 10000 steps including validation/checkpoint overhead. Retain all three proposed milestones from one continuing native optimizer/RNG/sampler state.
